summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for AP7313-33SRG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3, fixed-ldo): evaluated 37 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 9 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 1 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 8 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-23-3 (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (None).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (MLCC stable) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 1 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (150 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (6 V rec / 7 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
